description: MASONS delivery hooks. At session start, restore identity (a move or a branch keeps the conversation's Session key; on Desktop a `clear`/`fork` start otherwise records a new one) and, once after a first install with no credential, tell the agent to give its principal the link; on each user prompt (UserPromptSubmit), stand down this window's receiver, deliver presentation-pending inbound and refresh the task hint; on idle notifications, surface attention state in the terminal title; at tool boundaries (PostToolUse), deliver presentation-pending inbound; at each turn's end (Stop), stop this session's typing and record the Session's last message to its principal; on an idle prompt, stop its typing too. At each turn's end (Stop, or StopFailure when an API error ends it), and at a cleared, resumed or moved session's start (SessionStart `clear` / `resume` / `fork`, which has no turn end until its first prompt), the receiver is armed mechanically: `arrival-receiver` runs in the background under asyncRewake (Claude Code's background hook whose exit code 2 starts a turn) and watches this session's presentation flag. When a message arrives it hands the turn to this window's mod (`arrival.ts`), which starts it as the plugin's message; where no mod claims it, the receiver exits code 2 so Claude Code starts the turn itself. That turn delivers the message — no model participation, no arming step; every failure path exits 0 and starts nothing. In a terminal window the same mod also runs /reload-plugins when a newer build of the plugin is installed.

hooks.command: B="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}"; C=; { IFS= read -r C < "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/channel.json"; } 2>/dev/null; N=${C#*'"pluginName":"'}; N=${N%%'"'*}; D="$B/$N/presentation-pending"; [ -n "$N" ] && [ -d "$D" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$D" 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/companion.mjs" tool-boundary
